confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on several Athens-specific sources that broadly agree, so they are the strongest. Accommodation is lower confidence: the hostel and hotel figures come from undated aggregator pages and a general Athens average across all hotel categories, and the July 2026 peak-season uplift is a judgement. The cocktail anchor is inferred from one craft-gin range (EUR 8-14) and a typical cocktail-to-beer ratio, not a direct price. Euro figures were converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR, which I did not verify with a search. The FX observation is stale: I could not retrieve a current RBA rate, so the 2026-03-20 value is the latest RBA figure I found and should be refreshed before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are based on Athens-specific sources. Greece-wide hostel averages were used only as a sanity check on dorm pricing.
